extracted.intended_audience: general readers; comedy students and practitioners interested in Upright Citizens Brigade
extracted.subtask_description: Overview of Upright Citizens Brigade's training and theatrical practices, including the curriculum they teach and the improvisational principles they emphasize (notably Del Close's teachings, the 'game' of the scene, and the Harold).

rubrics_metrics.name: Training curriculum
rubrics_metrics.description: The Upright Citizens Brigade Theatre Training Center teaches long-form improv, sketch, writing, parts of directing, and various other comedy skills.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: UCB's courses cover long-form formats (e.g., The Harold), sketch writing and performance, and basic directing; the curriculum is oriented toward preparing performers for theatre, television, film, and digital media.

rubrics_metrics.name: Philosophy: based on Del Close teachings
rubrics_metrics.description: The training center's philosophy of improv is based largely on the teachings of Del Close.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This signals an emphasis on long-form, ensemble-based scene work and the structural principles popularized by Del Close; UCB's pedagogy builds on Close's methods.

rubrics_metrics.name: Emphasis on the 'game' of the scene
rubrics_metrics.description: The training center places a strong emphasis on the 'game' of the scene.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Students are taught to identify the scene's central comedic pattern or unusual element ('the game') and to heighten and explore it through choices, repetition, and escalation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Primary improvisational form: The Harold
rubrics_metrics.description: The primary improvisational form is 'The Harold'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: UCB trains performers in The Harold as a central long-form structure; mastery of The Harold is presented as core to UCB-style improv practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: House 'Harold Teams' and regular performance
rubrics_metrics.description: The theater in all its incarnations has had a group of 'Harold Teams', house teams that perform regularly.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintaining house teams and regular performance opportunities is part of the training model—regular shows function as both practice and public showcases, reinforcing ensemble skills and the Harold form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Codification of method (UCB manual)
rubrics_metrics.description: In 2013, Besser, Roberts and Walsh co-authored a manual titled The Upright Citizens Brigade Comedy Improvisation Manual.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The existence of a manual indicates UCB's methods are codified and teachable; practitioners are expected to learn and apply these documented techniques.
